teaching_sequences.title: Deep cerebellar nuclei
teaching_sequences.objective: Identify source-defined deep cerebellar nuclei within reconstructed block C1.1.
teaching_sequences.instruction: Start with the whole tissue block and matching MRI context, then select each region and inspect its fine extent in all three image planes and the 3D view. Use adjacent sections to follow changes in the source assignment.
teaching_sequences.evidence_limit: Coverage: one author-reconstructed histological block. Fine boundaries are histological assignments; the ex vivo MRI supplies anatomical context at its own sampling. Source processing, engineering validation and instructor review have separate records.
teaching_sequences.step_prompt: Locate the highlighted source assignment, compare it with adjacent labels and describe its position in the matching MRI context.
teaching_sequences.step_question: Which source-defined structure is selected, which neighboring assignments are visible, and where does the tissue block end?
